test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 02 Sept, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The simple interest on a certain sum for 7(2)/(3) years at the rate of 5.4% per annum is Rs. 4,347. What will be the amount payable on the same sum at the rate of 7.5% per annum simple interest in 4(4)/(5) years?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total interest percentage for first case = 5.4% × 23/3 = 1.8% × 23 = 41.4%

Total interest percentage for second case = 7.5% × 24/5 = 1.5% × 24 = 36%

Given, 41.4% of sum = ₹4,347 ⇒ 1% of sum = 4347 ÷ 41.4 = 105

Amount percentage for second case = 100% (Principal) + 36% (Interest) = 136%

Required Amount = 105 × 136 = ₹14,280

**∴ The correct answer is ₹14,280.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Case 1: **SI₁** = ₹4,347, **Rate (R₁)** = 5.4%, **Time (T₁)** = 7 2/3 = 23/3 years

Case 2: **Rate (R₂)** = 7.5%, **Time (T₂)** = 4 4/5 = 24/5 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Amount (A) = P + SI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d91d7029bc4479247a106d5a83ae8ec449cb5ba58f6c081d76f5c37d0b514cb4.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ SI₁ = (P × R₁ × T₁) ÷ 100

⇒ 4347 = (P × 5.4 × 23/3) ÷ 100

⇒ 4347 = (P × 1.8 × 23) ÷ 100

⇒ 4347 = (P × 41.4) ÷ 100

⇒ P = (4347 × 100) ÷ 41.4 = ₹10,500

⇒ SI₂ = (10500 × 7.5 × 24/5) ÷ 100

⇒ SI₂ = 105 × 1.5 × 24 = 105 × 36 = ₹3,780

⇒ Amount (A₂) = P + SI₂ = 10,500 + 3,780 = ₹14,280

**∴ The correct answer is ₹14,280.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest (SI) Formula

Interest is calculated only on the initial principal. Formula: SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100, where P is principal, R is rate, and T is time in years.

Total Amount Formula

The final value payable is the sum of principal and interest: A = P + SI = P(1 + RT/100).

Effective Rate of Interest

The single rate that gives the same interest for a specific period as multiple successive rates: Rₑff = (R × T).
